## WIRE_KEYS variable

The control-record keys, one per wire value kind.

**Signature:**

```typescript
WIRE_KEYS: Readonly<{
  readonly integer: 'integer'
  readonly double: 'double'
  readonly date: 'date'
  readonly record: 'record'
  readonly reference: 'reference'
  readonly file: 'file'
  readonly fileSource: 'fileSource'
}>
```

## Remarks

These spellings are part of the wire protocol. They carry no `$` prefix because JSON-Schema tooling treats `$`<!-- -->-prefixed names such as `$ref` specially, even as property names.
